# Sparo Agent Browser

> **Sparo Agent Browser** — The browser built for AI agents — humans stay in control.
> **Sparo 人机同窗浏览器** — AI 驾驭网页，你驾驭 AI.
> Shared Chromium window + MCP. Any agent can drive it; humans pause & approve.

## Why

Browsers built only for humans constrain AI. Sparo Agent Browser explores an AI-first form humans can still accept: same window, same truth, agent as first-class operator.

## For agents (30s)

1. Read ./AGENTS.md
2. `npm run status` or GET http://127.0.0.1:3920/health
3. `npm run open -- https://example.com`  OR  MCP `navigate` + `get_url`
4. Call `sparo_info` if unsure

Human product story: ./README.md  
MCP setup: ./docs/AGENTS.md  
API reference: ./docs/MCP-API.md  
Architecture: ./docs/ARCHITECTURE.md
